orientation_sign.speaker: EMC Guide
orientation_sign.prompt_content: Read a short introduction to the EMC campus.
orientation_sign.text: Welcome to the EMC campus. Follow the path to explore the Animation, Game Development, and Multimedia laboratories.

terminal_welcome.speaker: Orientation Terminal
terminal_welcome.prompt_content: Use this terminal to begin your campus orientation.
terminal_welcome.text: Your first task is to explore the campus and interact with its learning stations.

library_door_locked.speaker: Laboratory Door
library_door_locked.text: Access granted. The Animation Laboratory is now open.

collectible_badge.speaker: Achievement
collectible_badge.prompt_content: Pick up this glowing Explorer Badge.
collectible_badge.text: You found an EMC Explorer Badge!

npc_campus_guide.speaker: Mika
npc_campus_guide.prompt_content: Talk to Mika for instructions on how to begin your EMC campus tour.
npc_campus_guide.text: Hi! Start by reading the orientation terminal, then visit the campus sign and Animation Laboratory.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Hi Mika, how do I begin the campus tour?

dialogue.speaker: Mika
dialogue.text: Would you like a quick overview or should I explain everything step by step?

dialogue.speaker: Mika
dialogue.text: Each station introduces a different part of Entertainment and Multimedia Computing.
